# Aegis — Telegram Group Management Bot

Aegis is an open-source, production-grade Telegram group management and moderation bot engineered and built by Sehaj Varma (https://sehaj.wasmer.app/). It provides deterministic moderation, sliding-window rate limiting, granular bitmask content locks, and forensic audit logs via SQLAlchemy 2.0.

- Canonical URL: https://aegis.wasmer.app/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/mrsehajofficial/aegis
- Creator & Architect: Sehaj Varma (https://sehaj.wasmer.app/)
- Full Documentation: https://aegis.wasmer.app/llms-full.txt

## Author & Maintainer
- Author: Sehaj Varma
- Personal Portfolio: https://sehaj.wasmer.app/

## Key Technical Specifications
- Language & Runtime: Python 3.11+, AsyncIO
- Framework: python-telegram-bot (PTB) v21+
- Persistence Layer: SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async ORM
- Database Backends: PostgreSQL (asyncpg) or SQLite (aiosqlite)
- License: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
- Deployment Targets: Docker Compose, systemd, Wasmer Edge

## Core Capabilities
1. Sliding-Window Anti-Flood: High-resolution temporal tracking of message bursts with sub-second automated throttling.
2. Granular Content Locks: 16 distinct content classes (voice notes, animated stickers, URLs, media forwards, bot commands) toggleable without admin privilege changes.
3. Deterministic Moderation Cascades: Non-probabilistic warnings, mutes, kicks, and bans without LLM latency or hallucination risks.
4. Forensic Audit Trail: ACID-compliant tamper-proof moderation action logging.
5. Telegram Business Automation: Keyword triggers, auto-replies, and out-of-office cooldowns.
